name: System monitor
author: WinDock
description: One performance metric (CPU, memory, GPU, disk, network or a HWiNFO sensor) as a graph, bar, ring, gauge, dial or number.

settings.label: Metric
settings.description: What it shows. HWiNFO's sensors are listed while HWiNFO runs with Shared Memory Support on; a metric that is not available now keeps its place and shows a dash.

settings.label: Label
settings.description: Empty: the metric's own name.

settings.label: Unit
settings.description: Empty: the metric's unit. Text here replaces it and shows the value unscaled.

settings.label: Decimals
settings.description: Scaled values under 10 (3.4 GB) get at least one.

settings.label: Scale
settings.description: Automatic turns big numbers into KB, MB or GB and long times into days and hours; raw shows plain bytes and seconds. Default: automatic.

choices.label: Automatic (KB, MB, GB; KB/s ... GB/s; days and hours)

settings.label: Update every
settings.description: The sampler runs at the fastest rate any widget asks for.

settings.label: Style
settings.description: How the value is drawn: a graph over time, a bar, a ring, a gauge, a dial or a number. Default: graph.

choices.label: Gauge (a half circle with a needle)
Value (a big number and its unit)

settings.label: History shown
settings.description: Graphs and sparklines (at most 600 samples).

settings.label: Show the label
settings.description: Writes the metric's name (or the label above). On by default.

settings.label: Show the value
settings.description: Writes the current value. On by default.

settings.label: Show the lowest and highest value (graphs) or the range (gauges, bars)
settings.description: Graphs mark the lowest and highest value shown; gauges, rings and bars show the ends of their range. Off by default.

settings.label: Line width
settings.description: How thick the line of a graph or sparkline is. Default: 2.

settings.label: Fill under the line (graph, sparkline)
settings.description: Shades the area under the line of a graph or sparkline. Off by default.

settings.label: Arc
settings.description: Gauge, dial and ring: 0 is the style's own (gauge 180, dial 240, ring 270); otherwise 90 - 300.

settings.label: Range from
settings.description: In the metric's own unit (bytes for memory). Both 0: the metric's range (rates: up to the highest value shown).

settings.label: Range to
settings.description: The top of the range, in the metric's own unit (see Range from). Default: 0.

settings.label: Smooth (the average of the last 3 samples)
settings.description: Shows the average of the last three samples, so the value jumps around less. Off by default.

settings.label: Colour
settings.description: #00000000 (transparent): the theme's accent colour.

settings.label: Warning from
settings.description: In the metric's own unit; 0: off.

settings.label: Warning colour
settings.description: The colour used once the value reaches Warning from. Default: amber.

settings.label: Critical from
settings.description: In the metric's own unit; 0: off.

settings.label: Critical colour
settings.description: The colour used once the value reaches Critical from. Default: red.

settings.label: Background
settings.description: What is drawn behind the widget: nothing, a dark panel, or the theme's label panel. Default: none.

settings.label: Text colour
settings.description: #00000000: the theme's text colour.

settings.label: Width on a top or bottom dock
settings.description: The height is the dock's icon size; a left or right dock shows a square. On the desktop the widget fills its window.
